title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall on 1970-01-10
lineage: Reel (Akai GX636) -> Apogee Mini-Me (24bit/96k) -> Apogee Mini-Dac -> Wavelab 5 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard capture of a raw, high‑energy show highlighted by a standout Love Light.
ai_review.review: The recording offers better‑than‑ever sound quality for this vintage tape, preserving the gritty, live atmosphere that fans love. The performance is praised for its hard‑jamming vibe and Pigpen’s fiery presence, with Love Light singled out as a highlight. Overall the set feels lively and unpolished in an appealing way.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 4‑5 stars, noting both strong musical moments (Love Light, hard jams) and a good‑to‑excellent soundboard source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers mention improved clarity compared to older circulations and describe the raw sound as reminiscent of early live tape ambience, indicating a clear but intentionally gritty mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as hard‑jamming with high energy, driven by Pigpen’s organ and vocal fire, giving the concert a lively, unfiltered flow.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ work is highlighted as fueling the fire of the performance.
